learning_outcomes.text: Decide when fine-tuning is justified versus prompting, RAG or longer context
Distinguish full fine-tuning, parameter-efficient methods (e.g. LoRA) and instruction tuning
Build and curate a high-quality supervised fine-tuning dataset
Run a fine-tune and read training signals such as loss and overfitting
Evaluate an adapted model against the base model honestly and guard against regressions
Weigh cost, maintenance and data-governance implications of owning a fine-tune

integrative_case: A company wants its assistant to always answer in a specific brand voice and format: decide whether fine-tuning beats prompting, pick a parameter-efficient method on a budget, curate and de-leak a supervised dataset, read the loss curves for overfitting, and compare honestly against the base model before adopting it.
